_comment: Reservation rules. Every value here is editable in the admin under Settings — this file is only the starting point the seed loads. Times, the deposit rate and the 12-guest phone rule are transcribed from the live varanasi.uk booking page; slot capacity and lead time are new (the old form had no availability logic at all) and should be confirmed by the restaurant.

slots._comment: The live site offered a fixed 5:00pm-10:00pm dropdown at 30-minute intervals, identical on both branches. Kept as-is.

capacity._comment: coversPerSlot is how many guests the kitchen will seat in one 30-minute slot. NOT taken from the old site (it had no limit) — a starting figure for the restaurant to confirm. Birmingham seats 150 in the main hall, Leicester is much smaller, hence the split.

leadTime._comment: How close to the sitting an online booking is still accepted. 90 minutes stops someone booking a table for 5 minutes' time.

deposit._comment: policy: 'always' takes a deposit on every booking; 'nights' only on the nights listed, which is what the live site does today (Fri/Sat/Sun, £10pp). Client asked for payment on every booking, so this ships as 'always' — flip it to 'nights' in the admin to go back to the published policy.
deposit.note: Your deposit is deducted from your final bill.

occasions._comment: The old form asked for the occasion as free text (and on Leicester the field was even typed as a telephone number). This is the dropdown that replaces it.

allergens._comment: The ten allergen checkboxes from the live booking form, unchanged.

consents._comment: Three required tick-boxes plus optional marketing, wording taken verbatim from the live form. The deposit line is reworded only because payment now happens during booking rather than by a link in the confirmation email.
consents.terms: I agree to the Varanasi Restaurant Terms & Conditions and GDPR Policy.
consents.deposit: I understand that deposits are non-refundable, and that I will need to give at least 24 hours' notice in order to move my booking to another date.
consents.depositRate: I understand that a £10 deposit per person is required before the booking is confirmed, and that this amount will be deducted off the bill.
consents.marketing: I'd like to hear about events, new menus and offers from Varanasi.

notifications._comment: Where new booking alerts go. Set to Sathish's address for testing; change to the branch reservations inboxes before launch.

vouchers._comment: Gift vouchers. Values are what guests see as buttons; a custom amount is allowed between min and max. Expiry is months from purchase — 12 is the figure already in the old settings, and UK gift vouchers must be honoured for at least the stated period.

followUp._comment: The after-dining message. Sent once a booking is marked completed: a thank you, a Google review link, and a complimentary voucher towards the next visit. Set 'enabled' to false to stop it, or complimentaryPence to 0 to send the review request without a voucher. Google review URLs must be the client's own — get them from the Google Business Profile 'Ask for reviews' short link.

whatsapp._comment: WhatsApp needs a Meta Business account, a verified business, and templates approved in advance — outside a 24-hour window only approved templates can be delivered. Until credentials are set, messages are written to data/outbox so the wording can be reviewed and submitted for approval. The bodies to submit are in src/lib/whatsapp.ts.
whatsapp._notifyToComment: A UK mobile that gets a WhatsApp the moment a table is booked. Editable in Admin -> Settings. Leave blank for none. Like every other WhatsApp message this needs an approved Meta template before it can actually be delivered; until then it is written to data/outbox.

analytics._comment: GA4 only loads after a visitor accepts cookies, and only if a measurement ID is set. The old site had no analytics at all, so there is no historical baseline to preserve — install this at launch to start one.
